name: @cyberdeck/datajack
description: Datajack, the player of Cyberdeck games: profiles, library, desktop shell

scripts.typecheck: vue-tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && tsc -p tsconfig.desktop-tests.json
scripts.build:desktop: vite build && vite build --config vite.electron.config.ts --mode main && vite build --config vite.electron.config.ts --mode preload
scripts.package:desktop: npm run build:desktop && node ../desktop/scripts/packageApp.mjs Datajack datajack
scripts.package:desktop:windows: npm run build:desktop && node ../desktop/scripts/packageApp.mjs Datajack datajack win32
